newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures slash gains, hit new lows.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures slash gains, hit new lows.

text.p: May 28 - IMM currency futures turned mixed, some erased big gains, hit fresh day's lows in busy trade. Marks fell in fast-market conditions after Bundesbank rejected Bonn gold, currency revalution plan. Bonn coalition subsequently said it would stick with plans to revalue Buba reserves. June mark slid below supports, including $0.5890 or about 1.70 spot.
